page_title: CEL 0-3 OVI | Celta Vigo v Oviedo 12/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+2' Rahim Alhassane (Real Oviedo) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
90+1' Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
85' Celta Vigo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

84' Aaron Escandell pulls off a fantastic save! Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the top of the net, but the effort is kept out. Celta Vigo get a corner.
83' The substitution has been made. Thiago Borbas has replaced Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo).
83' That will be all from Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Rahim Alhassane.

80' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Aaron Escandell pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.

78' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Miguel Ortiz with no other option than to blow for a foul.
78' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
77' Celta Vigo failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
76' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Celta Vigo.
74' Jorge Guillermo Almada Alves has decided to make a change. David Costas replaces Alberto Reina (Real Oviedo).
74' Here comes a substitution. Nicolas Fonseca is given a rest as he is replaced by Santiago Colombatto (Real Oviedo).
70' Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
69' Nicolas Fonseca (Real Oviedo) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
69' Miguel Ortiz shows a yellow card to Nicolas Fonseca (Real Oviedo) for his blatant foul.
68' Alberto Reina (Real Oviedo) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
66' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Thiago Fernandez as he is replaced by Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo).
63' Neat passing move from Celta Vigo in order to create new attacking opportunities.
60' The referee signals a substitution. Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) is brought on as a substitute for Williot Swedberg.
60' Here is a change. Alvaro Nunez is going off and Claudio Giraldez gives the last tactical orders to Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo).
60' It's time for a substitution. Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) comes on in place of Pablo Duran.
57' 0 - 3 It's in the back of the net! Thiago Fernandez plays it into the box, and Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the back of the net. 0:3.
56' Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
54' Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) is furious with himself as he misses a clear opportunity from the six-yard box. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the left post.

54' It's unbelievable, Javi Lopez (Real Oviedo) blows a huge opportunity! He is totally unmarked and fires a first-time shot towards the left post from a few yards out, but Ionut Radu reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
54' Oviedo will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
51' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) sends a cross into the box, but Ionut Radu comes off his line to gather the ball.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Andres Antanon (Celta Vigo) is replaced by Iago Aspas.
46' Claudio Giraldez has made a change at the break. Ilaix Moriba has come on in place of Matias Vecino (Celta Vigo).
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.

45' 0 - 2 It's a goal! Ilyas Chaira plays the ball to the feet of Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo), who hits a tremendous first-time shot inside the right post. The goalkeeper was unable to keep it out. 0:2.
43' Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle and it's Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
39' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post.
37' The resulting corner from Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) is cleared.
36' Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play. Celta Vigo are awarded a corner kick.
33' Rough tackle by Nicolas Fonseca (Real Oviedo). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
31' Half-chance! Thiago Fernandez (Real Oviedo) plays a pass into the box, but Ionut Radu reacts well to snuff out the attack.
29' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
27' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) bends a great shot in from the edge of the box, but Ionut Radu makes a smart save to deny him.
24' Alberto Reina (Real Oviedo) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
22' Thiago Fernandez (Real Oviedo) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Miguel Ortiz has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
19' The Celta Vigo players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
15' That was a wasted opportunity to score by Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo). He picks up the rebound and produces a poor effort which is easily saved by the goalkeeper.
15' Andres Antanon (Celta Vigo) picks up the rebound and shoots. The goalkeeper was ready and denies his effort with a fine save.
12' Oviedo keep hold of the ball with numerous one-two passes, but one error and they surrender possession.
9' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
7' Celta Vigo seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
4' 0 - 1 Goal! Alberto Reina (Real Oviedo) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 0:1.
2' Celta Vigo have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

2' Andres Antanon (Celta Vigo) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!

The players are on the pitch and Oviedo will have the kick-off.
Miguel Ortiz is the one to supervise the game today.
